summary: Tested Stripe checkout, profile memory toggle, chat suggestion trigger, suggestion list/confirm APIs, and mobile web UI integration. Stripe monthly/annual responses are stable and graceful with invalid key. Memory toggle works in backend and UI. 10th-turn profile suggestion could not be validated end-to-end due /api/chat failing with llm_error budget exceeded (502).

critical.issue: LLM integration returns 502 during multi-turn flow: `llm_error ... Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: ~1.406, Max budget: 1.4`. This blocks verification of 10th-message profile_suggestion trigger and chat suggestion UI card.

ui_bugs.issue: `chat-profile-suggestion-card` did not appear after 10 messages in tested run, so accept/reject buttons were not testable end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by upstream LLM budget-exceeded 502 from /api/chat before/around extraction window.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: `shadow*` deprecation and `useNativeDriver` fallback on web (non-blocking for this test scope).

action_items: Fix CRITICAL LLM budget/integration issue on /api/chat first; then re-run 10th-turn profile_suggestion validation and UI accept/reject card flow.
After chat stability is restored, re-run end-to-end: memory ON => suggestion appears at 10th user message; memory OFF => no suggestion.
Keep Stripe fallback behavior as expected for current invalid key environment (**MOCKED** checkout fallback is correct and graceful).
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe checkout endpoint does not hardcode frontend URLs; it derives base URL via env/origin/request host in `_frontend_base_url`.
`/api/stripe/checkout-session` gracefully handles invalid Stripe key by returning `{checkoutUrl:null, mock:true, message}` (expected **MOCKED** behavior).
`server.py` still includes fallback defaults for sensitive envs (`STRIPE_API_KEY` fallback `sk_test_emergent`, `ADMIN_TOKEN` fallback). This weakens fail-fast behavior for config mistakes.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (memory toggle flow passed; suggestion-card flow blocked by backend chat integration failure)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed device-scoped data and seeded pending profile_suggestions docs for confirm accept/reject API validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. UI memory toggle triggers real API calls (observed two 200 responses to /api/profile/memory). Confirm accept/reject endpoints are functional with pending suggestions. End-to-end trigger remains blocked until /api/chat budget issue is resolved.
rca_of_issue: Repro: send repeated POST /api/chat in same conversation to reach 10th-turn extraction window with memory enabled. Observed response 502 with `llm_error ... Budget has been exceeded`. Because suggestion extraction depends on successful chat completion, profile_suggestion payload and UI card never materialize. Mitigation: raise/reset LLM budget or add fallback handling/retry policy for extraction path; then retest trigger and UI card accept/reject flow.
